title: Selena Saturday, free beach movie, Hermosa volleyball all weekend
intro: Post–Labor Day weekend. Torrance wraps Summer Nights with a Selena tribute and Hispanic Heritage Festival on Saturday, Hermosa has free Pirates on the sand plus pro volleyball at the pier through Sunday, and Moompetam runs both days at the Aquarium of the Pacific. Cards below. We left parking, food, and prices blank unless we could confirm them on an official page.

picks.name: 512: The Selena Experience + Hispanic Heritage Festival
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free entry. Torrance Summer Nights season finale.
picks.parking: Columbia Park lot. Official event page does not list a parking fee.
picks.food: City page mentions food as part of the festivities; vendor prices unknown.
picks.why: Selena tribute with mariachi opener at the inaugural Hispanic Heritage Festival.

picks.name: Movies at the Beach: Pirates of the Caribbean
picks.when: Saturday, September 12 (sunset on the sand; series also lists Saturday, September 19)
picks.address: Sand south of the Hermosa Beach Pier
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free. Donations appreciated (Friends of the Parks). Exact showtime not listed as a clock time on the official page — sunset screening.
picks.parking: Official page does not list parking rates. Beach/pier parking gets tight; walk, bike, or arrive early.
picks.food: Official page does not list food vendors. Bring snacks; pack out trash.
picks.why: Free Pirates of the Caribbean on the sand. Bring blankets and low-back chairs.

picks.name: Wedbush Hermosa Beach Open
picks.when: Thursday–Sunday, September 10–13, 2026 (qualifier Thu; main draw Fri–Sun)
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free admission all four days. Official tournament site.
picks.parking: Official site does not list a parking fee. Pier-area parking is limited on tournament weekends.
picks.food: Official site does not break out food prices. Eat nearby on Pier Ave or pack snacks.
picks.why: Pro beach volleyball with free admission and a free livestream. Easy weekend stop with kids.

picks.name: Moompetam American Indian Festival
picks.address: Aquarium of the Pacific, 100 Aquarium Way
picks.cost_math: 2 adults (12+) + 2 kids (3–11): $49.95 + $49.95 + $34.95 + $34.95 = $169.80 entry. Under 3 free. Members free with reservation. Plus $8 validated Aquarium parking = ~$177.80. Reservations required.
picks.parking: Aquarium parking structure: $8 flat with Aquarium validation (official Address & Parking page).
picks.food: Aquarium cafes on site; festival page does not break out food prices. Eat first if you want to save.
picks.why: Craft demos, storytelling, music, and dance celebrating California Indigenous maritime cultures. Included with general admission.

picks.name: Lowe's Kids Workshop: Haunted House
picks.when: Saturday, September 12, 10:00 a.m.–1:00 p.m. (in-store slots; registration required)
picks.address: Register for a participating store slot on Lowes.com (Torrance store commonly listed at 22255 S Western Ave — confirm in the registration picker)
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free workshop. Materials included. Registration required; confirmation email/QR is your ticket.
picks.parking: Store lot. Official event page does not list a parking fee.
picks.food: Official page does not list food. Eat first.
picks.why: Free haunted-house build for mini DIYers. Spots fill — register before you drive.
picks.age_gate: Kids workshop; register child profiles on Lowes.com.

picks.name: Madrona Marsh Nature Walk
picks.address: Madrona Marsh Nature Center, 3201 Plaza Del Amo
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free. No registration required.
picks.parking: Nature Center lot. Official page does not list a fee.
picks.food: Official page does not list food. Eat first or pack light.
picks.why: Docent-led intro to plants and wildlife at the preserve. Weather can cancel — call (310) 782-3989 for status.

picks.name: Hermosa Beach Concert Series
picks.address: Beach south of the Hermosa Beach Pier
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free. City Parks & Recreation series page: two Sundays after Labor Day at 3:00 p.m. south of the Pier.
picks.parking: Official series page does not list parking rates. Pier parking is limited; walk or arrive early.
picks.food: Official page does not list food. Pack a picnic.
picks.why: Free beach concert series right after Labor Day. Easy Sunday with kids on the sand.

picks.name: Sensory Sensitive Saturday at Cabrillo Marine Aquarium
picks.address: Cabrillo Marine Aquarium, 3720 Stephen M. White Drive
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free entry (suggested donation $10 adult / $5 child on the admission page — not required). Parking: cars $3/hr, $9 daily max, card only (official CMA admission page).
picks.parking: Cabrillo Beach lot: $3/hr, $9 daily max, credit/debit only per CMA admission page.
picks.food: Picnic areas in Cabrillo Coastal Park. Official sensory page does not list food vendors.
picks.why: Quieter hour for sensory-sensitive guests; sensory bags and lap pads available at the welcome booth.

picks.name: Movies at the Beach (week 2)
picks.address: Sand south of the Hermosa Beach Pier
picks.parking: Official page does not list parking rates.
picks.food: Official page does not list food vendors. Bring snacks.
picks.why: Second free Movies at the Beach night. Confirm the title on hermosamovies.com before you go.

picks.name: El Segundo Main Street Fair
picks.cost_math: 2 adults + 2 kids: free to walk the fair. Kids games / food / crafts priced individually (amounts not listed on the Kiwanis page). Beer garden is the adult zone.
picks.parking: Official Kiwanis page does not list parking rates. Street closures on Main; plan to park nearby and walk.
picks.food: Food court and local restaurant fair deals on site. Prices vary.
picks.why: Eight blocks of crafts, kids games, food, and live music. Kiwanis fundraiser for local kids.

picks.name: Baja Splash Cultural Festival
picks.address: Aquarium of the Pacific, 100 Aquarium Way
picks.cost_math: Further out — Aquarium admission + $8 validated parking; reservations required. Tickets sell.
picks.why: Watch list — reserve if you want the cultural festival weekend.

picks.name: Torrance Farmers Market
picks.cost_math: Free to stroll. City lists Wilson Park / Jefferson St area; year-round Tue/Sat.
picks.why: Easy Saturday morning produce + playground stop.

picks.name: Musica Para Todos with Nathalia Music
picks.cost_math: Hermosa Beach Library. Ages 0–5 with caregiver.
picks.why: Short bilingual music program for littles.

picks.name: Native Garden Restoration at Cabrillo
picks.cost_math: Free program. Parking $3/hr, $9 daily max (card only) if you drive.
picks.why: Hands-on native garden help with aquarium educators. Kids with an adult.

picks.name: Nature Journaling at Cabrillo
picks.cost_math: Free and open to all ages; registration not required (CMA Nature Journaling page). Parking $3/hr, $9 max.

picks.name: Family Storytime (North Torrance Library)
picks.why: Songs and stories for the whole family.
